summary:
Consolidated 3-Tier Web3 Architecture & Gemini Intelligence Bridge Plan:
1. Intelligence Layer: Gemini API Function Calling schema parser (prepareTransfer, prepareSwap, prepareLiquidityMint) converting natural language prompts into deterministic structured parameters.
2. Orchestration Layer: Client/backend transaction serializer using ethers.js/viem to encode ABI calldata, calculate nonces, and estimate EIP-1559 gas fees.
3. Multi-Mode Signing & Custody Layer:
   - Mode A: Non-Custodial User Wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase, Rabby via EIP-6963).
   - Mode B: Embedded MPC Passkey Wallet (WebAuthn PRF / sharded key simulation).
   - Mode C: Autonomous Agent TEE Enclave with ERC-4337 Session Keys, 24h spending caps ($50/day default), and contract allow-lists.
4. JSON-RPC Node Layer: Live query and mempool broadcasting (eth_sendRawTransaction) to Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum.
